PaymentService/Authorize.threeds_manual_capture_credit_card: Barclaycard 3DS is handled via the PaymentMethodAuthenticationService suites (PreAuthenticate/Authenticate/PostAuthenticate); the standalone threeds scenario which expects browser-based redirect is not applicable
PaymentService/Authorize.no3ds_fail_payment: Barclaycard sandbox decline card is not the global 4000000000000002; a Barclaycard-specific decline card number must be configured in override.json once verified against the CI sandbox credentials

PaymentMethodAuthenticationService/PostA.threeds_card_post_authenticate: PostAuthenticate requires a live 3DS flow (PreAuthenticate → Authenticate → PostAuthenticate) that depends on a prior redirect from the ACS; cannot be tested in isolation without browser automation
